decision: Treat model quality, Parakeet parsing, and Linux insertion as separate failure domains
why: Neither engine receives screen content, while History stores engine output before insertion
result: Do not attribute copied screen text to Parakeet vision or model quality

decision: Evaluate Large v3 Turbo Q5_0 as the capable-machine default
why: Small is materially weaker multilingual; Echo already pins the 574 MB Q5 Turbo artifact
result: Arena candidates compare a Turbo-first policy against alternatives

decision: Fix Parakeet output at the subprocess boundary
why: Pinned sherpa-onnx emits a JSON object; Echo currently returns all successful stdout as transcript
result: Require an exact JSON-to-text regression before the adapter change

decision: Prefer correct paste contents over clipboard restoration
why: ClipboardOnly currently restores the old clipboard and Pasted restores before the target acknowledges the selection
result: Arena candidates must choose an explicit clipboard lifetime invariant

decision: Recommend Turbo Q5_0 at 8 GiB and keep Engine Auto stable
why: Turbo has the best supported speed-quality-size balance, but this host cannot measure low-memory peak RSS or justify migrating existing Auto users
result: New Recommended setups pin Turbo; Base remains the conservative fallback; existing Auto semantics remain compatible

decision: Leave transcript on the clipboard after fallback
why: One-shot clipboard ownership is not portable across X11 and XWayland, and any restore delay is arbitrary
result: Delete restoration, keep direct typing clipboard-free, prefer session-native write tool

decision: Use LanguageOptions.mode as the Settings projection boundary
why: It is already produced by backend resolution and avoids a new IPC snapshot
result: Rename the row to Speech model and render fixed Parakeet metadata when resolved

decision: Do not override threads or enable Flash Attention in production
why: The runtime defaults and optimal thread count vary by CPU; Flash Attention can regress CPU-only builds
result: Keep VAD and Q5 quantization; ship a benchmark lever before adding hardware tuning

decision: Run the full local release gate
why: The change crosses Rust, TypeScript, CLI, archive extraction, and release packaging
evidence: cargo test and clippy, frontend test and Playwright, verify scripts, target/release/echo-desktop
result: All local checks green; real model matrix remains unrun on this macOS host
